fishing: WHEN: Sat Nov 21 good solunar (74/100), winds N 3-12 mph, air 69-80F, water ~74F. PASSES-BEACH: Spanish mackerel, bluefish, ladyfish, flounder, snook, jacks, blue runners at Englewood Beach / Manasota / Blind Pass / Stump Pass / Boca Grande; live shrimp, gold spoons. LEMON BAY: trout, redfish, snook, baby gags scattered Miserable Mile to Ainger Creek; Spanish/ladyfish/bluefish along ICW and Stump Pass. NEARSHORE: mixed when seas allow. Baits: live shrimp, pilchards, soft plastics, paddletails, weedless spoons. Sources: Fishin Franks Nov 20 (Spanish/ladyfish/bluefish/jacks passes & beaches, trout/reds/snook/baby gags Lemon Bay), FL Sportsman SW / Capt. Mike recent reports.
redtide: FWC Nov 20 update: K. brevis at very low concentrations in one Charlotte County sample in SWFL. Bloom concentrations in NWFL (Bay and Gulf counties). No bloom near Englewood/Manasota. No SWFL fish kills or respiratory irritation reported. Next update Nov 24.
bacteria: Charlotte/Sarasota Healthy Beaches all Good. Manasota Key Beach GOOD (10 CFU/100mL Nov 16). Englewood Beach / Manasota Key GOOD (~10 CFU/100mL recent samples). No advisories.
fpl: Charlotte ~2-7 / Sarasota ~28-149 minor isolated outages; no major Englewood/Manasota impact.
